Workload_Hub_Slogan: AI-powered data contract enforcement across Fabric
Workload_Hub_Description: Orqentis enforces ODCS data contracts across Lakehouses, Warehouses, Eventhouses, Semantic Models, and Fabric SQL in Microsoft Fabric.
Workload_Hub_GetStarted_1_Description: Author ODCS v3.1.0 contracts against any Fabric data source and let AI co-author and score breaches.
ContractItem_Description: An ODCS v3.1.0 data contract for a Fabric data source (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Eventhouse, Semantic Model, or Fabric SQL).
ContractItem_RunNow_Tooltip: Queue an enforcement run for the selected contract.
ContractPolicyItem_Description: Enforcement policy + Activator routing for a contract.
ContractReportItem_Description: Read-only enforcement run history for a contract.
